main.description: One merger matter on the ACCC's public acquisitions register: an acquisition notified under Australia's mandatory merger regime, or an application for a notification waiver. The record key is the ACCC's own matter identifier (e.g. MN-01016), so a matter is addressable at at://<did>/fyi.mergers.matter/MN-01016 without a lookup. Published by mergers.fyi, which mirrors the register; the ACCC is the source and does not itself publish to the ATmosphere.

matterId.description: ACCC public register matter identifier, e.g. "MN-01016". Always equal to this record's key.

title.description: Matter name as the register gives it, usually "Acquirer - Target".

summary.description: The ACCC's description of the proposed acquisition, as published. The cap is well clear of the longest on the register; anything past it is truncated rather than dropped.

matterType.description: Whether the matter is a notified acquisition or an application for a notification waiver.

phase.description: Stage the matter has reached. A matter referred to phase 2 keeps its phase 1 determination in determinations, and one that moves on to the public benefit phase keeps its phase 2 determination.

url.description: Canonical page for the matter on mergers.fyi.

registerUrl.description: The matter's own page on the ACCC public register - the source of everything in this record.

notifiedOn.description: Effective notification date as YYYY-MM-DD: the date the statutory clock runs from, which is not the original notification date where a matter was refiled or the clock was reset.

originallyNotifiedOn.description: Date the matter was first notified, as YYYY-MM-DD. Differs from notifiedOn only where the clock was reset.

determinationDueBy.description: End of the statutory determination period as YYYY-MM-DD, while one is running.

consultationClosesOn.description: Closing date for submissions to the ACCC's consultation, as YYYY-MM-DD.

determinations.description: Determinations made on the matter, oldest first. Empty while the matter is open.

indexedAt.description: When mergers.fyi last wrote this record. Only moves when something in the matter changed, so it is a real last-changed signal rather than a publishing heartbeat.
